title: Web & API Layer
desc: The FastAPI app, routers, WebSocket, and the gateway sub-app.
lede: The web layer is a FastAPI app: domain routers for the UI, a WebSocket for live updates, and the gateway mounted as a sub-app.
body:
At a glance
  • web.py mounts and lifecycle.
  • Domain routers behind the UI.
  • ws.py broadcasts live updates.
  • Jobs moving from REST polling to WebSocket.

App & routers

FastAPI hosts domain routers (projects, chapters, voices, queue, and more) plus the external gateway as a mounted sub-app. See Internal HTTP API Reference and TTS Gateway API.

Live updates

A WebSocket broadcasts progress and state so the UI updates without polling; queue updates are migrating from REST polling to the WebSocket.
